title: Provider JMAP Chat subset
description: Implement JMAP Chat C2S subset on the provider: Session, Chat (read-only projection of MIMI room state), Message (E2EE mode, application/mimi-content, senderMsgId per R1 decision), WSS delivery. Dev bearer-token auth issued via admin CLI. See decision mimid-1wgh.9.
notes: Per mimid-1wgh.30: build on ~/PROJECT/crate-jmap jmap-chat-server + jmap-chat-types. First: check their conformance to current draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 and whether E2EE mode is supported.
